annotations.title: Search the construction calculators and pages

description: Searches the site's construction pages for a question in everyday words, such as how much concrete or tile a job needs, and returns the matching pages: id, kind, title, link, description and slug. It finds; it computes nothing.

kinds.description: Only these kinds of result; every kind when left out.

query.description: What to find, such as "concrete slab" or "skirting board".

name: search

id.description: The result's id: calculator:{slug}, takeoff:{id}, example:{slug} or diagnosis:{slug}.

title: Search the construction calculators and pages
